findings.rule: Claude Code's is the only one known, so any other harness installs no bundle and gets a composer error that names the harness.
findings.input: compose() with resolved.harness != "claude-code" (e.g. CLAUDECODE unset) and a profile with no skills and no hooks, such as the shipped general.yml (skills: []) that a no-order session resolves to by default
findings.finding: The composer only appends the "harness ... has no known skill format" error when the profile declares skills or hooks, so a non-Claude-Code harness resolving to a bundle-less profile (general, probe) installs no bundle and produces no composer error at all, contrary to the unconditional rule that any other harness gets a composer error naming the harness.
